headlines.description: Denver's dominant defense came up big against Cam Newton again, and the Broncos escaped with a 21-20 victory over the Panthers on Thursday night when Graham Gano missed a 50-yard field goal.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos escape as Panthers' winner sails left

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Jameis Winston threw four touchdown passes, and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers claimed a winning record for the first since 2012 by opening the season with a 31-24 victory over the Atlanta Falcons.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston throws 4 TD passes, Bucs beat Falcons 31-24

headlines.description: Eric Kendricks returned an interception 77 yards for a touchdown late in the third quarter and Danielle Hunter scored a 24-yard TD off a fumble return and the Vikings beat the Titans 25-16.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings score 2 TDs off turnovers in beating Titans 25-16

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Alex Smith dived for a touchdown on the first possession of overtime, completing the Kansas City Chiefs' frantic rally from a 17-point fourth-quarter deficit to beat the San Diego Chargers 33-27
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs overcome 17-point deficit, beat Chargers 33-27 in OT

events.name: Oakland Raiders at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: David Carr hit Seth Roberts for a 10-yard touchdown with 47 seconds left, then connected with Michael Crabtree on a 2-point conversion, and the Oakland Raiders edged the New Orleans Saints 35-34.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr, Raiders rally to beat Saints 35-34

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at New York Jets

headlines.description: Mike Nugent kicked a 47-yard field goal with 54 seconds left, lifting the Cincinnati Bengals to a 23-22 season-opening victory over the New York Jets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nugent's 47-yarder field goal leads Bengals past Jets 23-22

headlines.description: Carson Wentz had 278 yards passing and two touchdowns in a stellar NFL debut and the Philadelphia Eagles beat Robert Griffin III and the Cleveland Browns 29-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carson Wentz leads Eagles past Browns 29-10

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw two touchdown passes and ran for another score, leading the Green Bay Packers to a 27-23 victory against the Jacksonville Jaguars in the teams' season opener Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers accounts for 3 TDs, Packers beat Jaguars 27-23

headlines.description: The Baltimore Ravens used a touchdown pass by Joe Flacco, two field goals and a throwback defensive performance to beat the Buffalo Bills 13-7 on Sunday in their season opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens go on defensive in 13-7 win over Bills

headlines.description: Brock Osweiler threw for 231 yards and two touchdowns in his debut with Houston to lead the Texans and their revamped offense to a 23-14 win over the Chicago Bears on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Osweiler solid in debut to lead Houston over Bears 23-14

headlines.description: Russell Wilson pulled off another fourth-quarter comeback, throwing a 2-yard touchdown pass to Doug Baldwin with 31 seconds left, giving the Seattle Seahawks a 12-10 win over the Miami Dolphins.
headlines.shortLinkText: Behind Wilson, Seattle rallies for 12-10 win over Miami

events.name: New York Giants at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: Eli Manning threw for three touchdowns, including the go-ahead score to Victor Cruz in his first game in nearly two years, and the New York Giants beat the Dallas Cowboys 20-19 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning hits Cruz for go-ahead TD, Giants top Cowboys 20-19

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford took advantage of one last chance Sunday and Matt Prater redeemed himself with a 43-yard field goal with 8 seconds to give the Detroit Lions a 39-35 victory at Indianapolis.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prater gets redemption with late field in 39-35 win at Indy

events.name: New England Patriots at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: Jimmy Garoppolo, starting in place of suspended Tom Brady, threw for 264 yards and a touchdown, leading the depleted Patriots to a 23-21 victory over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jimmy Garoppolo helps Patriots beat Cardinals 23-21

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger recovered his own fumble at a pivotal moment and didn't look back, throwing three touchdown passes to lead the Pittsburgh Steelers to a 38-16 victory over the Washington Redski
headlines.shortLinkText: Roethlisberger throws for 3 TDs as Steelers beat Redskins

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: Carlos Hyde ran for 88 yards and two touchdowns and the San Francisco 49ers posted their first season-opening shutout in franchise history to spoil the Rams' first game since moving back to L.A.
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers open Chip Kelly era with 28-0 victory over Rams
